description: Slot 1: an Embla carousel of 5 icon cards with a supporting paragraph and a 5-dot pager. Background is `white` on five routes and the `dustToWhite` gradient (I2) on /chemicals only.

items.note: The REAL shape: 5 cards, each an array of 1-2 copy runs (the CMS splits a card’s text across runs; several carry a trailing space on the first run). Card 5 is the byte-identical CONTROL_CARD on all six routes.

aspectRatio.note: CSS aspect-ratio for the wrapper box (e.g. "799/617"). Used by Rive assets, which have no intrinsic pixel size, INSTEAD of intrinsicWidth/Height.

icons.note: Icons are a SHARED, index-matched list (src/data/industries.js ICON_SLIDER_ICONS), byte-identical on all six routes — they are not per-item fields.

constraints._variantRouteAllowlistNote: Each variant is pinned to the exact routes that really use it, read off the real content data. Enforced by compatibility/graph.json#VARIANT_ROUTE_ALLOWLIST at severity "error", keyed on (section, variant) — not on the bare section id.

variants.bg-dust-to-white: background = dustToWhite (/chemicals ONLY — the single differentiator between /chemicals and the other four static-hero routes)

motion.notes: Autoplay measured as delta 5971 / 6037ms -> 6000ms. Embla `duration: 25` reproduces the measured friction tween.

knownUpstreamDefects: The pager renders FIVE dots while only the first three snaps are reachable, and the counter denominator is the ITEM count (5) rather than the snap count. Reproduced on purpose.
notes: The supportingText on /shipping carries a real TRAILING SPACE.
copyBudgetDerivation: Each maxWords budget is max(measured+2, ceil(measured*1.25)). The measured maxima were computed by importing the real src/data/*.js modules and word-counting every string for that field across every route. See extraction/measured-values.json#copyBudgets.
